items.title: The Deal Ledger
items.text: A proprietary, AI-enabled database of deals, pricing and negotiated terms going back to 2004. We optimize thousands of deals every year across all technology categories.

items.title: Proven best practices
items.text: Most IT teams negotiate a major agreement every few years. We do it every day with the largest technology suppliers in the world, and we put that experience to work for you.

items.title: Specialist experts
items.text: Our experts combine IT and commercial negotiation skills, with over 25 years of experience on average. In most cases they know the supplier's business better than the supplier does.

finn.title: Market intelligence, one question away.
finn.text: Ledger is Fairmark's AI assistant. It answers in seconds by searching 22 years of market data and negotiated deals, so you can check pricing, supplier positioning and terms before your next call.

items.quote: We bring Fairmark into every new portfolio company in the first hundred days. The savings show up in the first quarter, and the supplier relationships come out stronger, not weaker.
Our roadmap said we needed to buy more licences. Fairmark showed us how to use the ones we already had, and renegotiated the rest. The budget we freed paid for two other projects.
An audit notice used to mean months of stress. Fairmark ran the process, found the real exposure and closed it out for a fraction of the supplier's first number.
We cut costs and ended up with better supplier partnerships at the same time. I did not think you could have both.
Clear expectations at every step, and they did exactly what they said they would. It is rare to work with advisors this direct.
A complicated renewal with a lot of moving parts. The team knew the supplier better than we did, and we came out well ahead.
